page: Microsoft Azure E32-16ds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the x86_64 architecture and hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8370C processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.8 GHz. This instance features a constrained vCPU configuration, exposing 16 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core). It is equipped with 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. The CPU instruction set features AVX-512 extensions including AVX512F and AVX512_VNNI, along with cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

A defining attribute of the E32-16ds_v5 is its high memory-to-compute ratio, providing 256.0 GB of system memory, which translates to 16.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage architecture includes a bundled 1288 GB local solid-state drive (SSD) for scratch space, caching, and temporary high-throughput I/O. The system does not include GPU acceleration and does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Synthetic performance benchmarks place its compute, memory subsystem, and execution speed within the middle 50 percent average across cloud instances, achieving a Geekbench multi-core score of 10115.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 21361.52.

The memory architecture yields uncached large-block read bandwidth of 101.12 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth of 58.35 GB/sec, with cached small-block reads scaling up to 834.58 GB/sec. In application-level benchmarks, the instance achieves 15.94 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 22.15 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. PassMark database operations register at 8047.55, reflecting strong throughput for transactional operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the constrained core architecture allows enterprises to run memory-intensive workloads that require large RAM footprints without paying for unnecessary software licenses tied to higher core counts. The combination of 256.0 GB RAM, 16 vCPUs, and 1288 GB of local SSD makes the E32-16ds_v5 well configured for large relational database management systems, in-memory caches such as Redis, enterprise analytics, and data-intensive ETL pipelines.
